name: Gorby
tagline: Find hard-to-read passages, repeated phrases and long sentences in drafts.
description: Gorby is a writing editor with readability metrics, sentence-length highlighting and checks for repeated or redundant wording. Its Mac desktop app requires Apple silicon. Local writing checks can run offline, while optional AI features require a connection.
pricingDetails: Free tier. One-year license $75 or lifetime $150.
